verdict.rationale: The Cart MCP docs list create_cart, get_cart, update_cart and cancel_cart as JSON-RPC tools on each merchant's /api/ucp/mcp endpoint, and Checkout MCP can turn a cart into a checkout. A runtime probe created a real cart keylessly on Shopify's hardware store via `ucp cart create` and got back a live Cart gid. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of the update_cart call, since only cart creation was exercised live.
